signals.summary: Short-form videos of dramatic real rescues and unlikely interspecies bonds — a terrified dog finally caught, a cat stuck in a tree, a kitten that heals a grieving dog. The candid rescue-and-reunion beat is the single richest vein of genuine animal moments this run.
signals.why_now: 6 fresh The Dodo uploads in the last 24h (2.2h, 16.2h, 18.2h, 20.2h, 22.2h, 24.2h); spans rescue-evasion and interspecies-friendship sub-beats. Single channel, so breadth is narrow despite the recency.
